facts: DeepEval 4.2.6 has llm/hybrid/system_one modes; TypeSafeModel is passed as system_one_model.
system_one uses bundled questions; JevEval supplies custom Noul/Score/Choice questions.
Six cases, three metrics, three repeats. Timing covers evaluate() only, cost sums evaluation_cost. Grounded and standard definitions have different expectation denominators.
Reasons-enabled experiment: Jev 0.46 seconds and USD 0.000330; gpt-5.4 4.39 seconds and USD 0.089058. Separate no-reason experiment: 0.47 versus 3.21 seconds. Conditions must not be combined.

articles.title: Kiro Web にローカルの .kiro 設定をアップロードしてみた
articles.timestampEvidence: Embedded datePublished; earlier checkpoint independently matched public RSS
facts: Local-to-cloud configuration upload is one-way, separate from applying cloud settings to new local sessions.
Whole ~/.kiro upload was rejected. Supported child directories such as steering, settings, skills and agents were imported.
Eight steering files imported. Some custom-agent PDF files exceeded the observed 4 MB upload limit.
Imported MCP settings kept local executable paths and failed during use. Import success does not prove runtime-dependency portability.
Explicit custom-agent selection limitations were observed in Kiro Web. End-to-end equivalence with the local setup was not demonstrated.

articles.title: QdrantからZilliz Cloudへ移行する方法――データ移行から検索確認まで
articles.timestampEvidence: Original JSON-LD datePublished; distinguished from last update time
facts: Vendor-affiliated author sphereSky at Zilliz, Inc.; public tutorial, not an independent comparative benchmark. Private demo recording not accessed.
Console migration maps collection, database, schema and index parameters; demonstration uses FLOAT_VECTOR 384, COSINE and AUTOINDEX, with 1178 total/indexed entities.
Article states payload type inference samples 100 rows; uncommon fields and mixed types still need full-data checks. Enabling AutoID discards source IDs.
Index creation and collection load are separate after migration. Search Data success checks reachability and query execution, not retrieval equivalence.
No proven continuous incremental-write synchronization or zero-downtime cutover. Stable IDs, filters, embedding contract and post-cutover writes require application-level verification.

articles.title: GPU なしの Ubuntu 24.04 に Amazon DCV でリモートデスクトップ環境を作る手順
articles.timestampEvidence: Embedded original datePublished; author testing date is September 25
facts: Tested Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS on GPU-less m7i.xlarge in ap-northeast-1, gp3 50 GiB, Amazon DCV 2025.0 r20103. This is a configuration walkthrough, not a graphics benchmark.
GNOME/GDM3 uses Xorg rather than Wayland; XDummy and Mesa provide a GPU-less software-rendered console session.
No security-group ingress was opened. Systems Manager forwards local 8443 to instance 8443; SSM IAM access and OS/PAM login are distinct authorization layers.
DCV on EC2 has no additional DCV license charge, but instance/storage charges remain. Regional license-bucket read access is required.
Server UDP listening does not prove QUIC use: observed client connections through the SSM tunnel used WebSocket. Startup time and usable remote desktop do not establish GPU-workload performance.
